title: National Museum of Ethiopia
geometryBasis: OpenStreetMap way 200657467 identifies the named permanent exhibition building. Steps way 1535018949 joins the east entrance to the museum grounds.
sectionBasis: The September 2016 cleared photograph fixes the raised glazed level, board-formed concrete fins, broad east stair, canopy and sloping foundation bays. The facade artwork is outside the architectural reconstruction. Exact roof and secondary elevations remain approximate.
limitations: September 2016 exterior of the permanent exhibition building. The adjacent temporary exhibition and museum grounds are outside this model.
The artwork above the main entrance is represented by a plain recess. The attached sign, roof profile and the less visible west wall are simplified.
Entrance grade and facade dimensions are approximate. The 128-meter source elevation field is preserved without grading or flattening.
